name: SPM Telecom data-center hosting facility
notes: Official SPM Telecom site labels its hosting section as 'Hebergement Data Center' and its offer endpoint lists 'Hebergement en Data Center' for 1U to multiple racks, with power distribution, generators, UPS, fire suppression, access control, camera surveillance, and proximity to the operator network core. The offer text says customers can host servers in one of SPM Telecom's data centers in the archipelago. Public pages do not disclose capacity or an exact facility address; assigned to Saint-Pierre based on SPM Telecom's Saint-Pierre presence/contact and absence of division-specific Miquelon-Langlade data-center evidence.
